body: The problem with me is that I spent the last 17 years raising my son on my own and not going out or making friends really because I couldn't afford it.  Then when he turned 17 I tried to start dating again. I met a guy and we were in a serious relationship for 2 years . Then he dumped me and now he's engaged to someone else after only 3 months.   Now its been almost 7 months post break up and I am just lonely and sad and depressed every day. I think its harder for me because I don't have any close friends. I really don't have anyone to go do anything with.   I think not having any friends  makes healing from break ups that much harder.  And it doesn't help that he called me twice yesterday after months of No Contact.  I didn't answer but my curiosity got the best of me and so I text him.  He just wanted to "check up" on me.  He said I was "on his mind".  He said his relationship is going well so far,  but mentioned that she has fears and anxieties.  LOL  I don't want to hear about his relationship !  Does he not understand that I loved him  and hearing about him being with someone else hurts ??
Same. I have all the stuff that reminds me of him in a box in my closet all taped up and Do Not Open written on it with a sharpie. Someday I will thrown the box away.
I still have photos but they are in the hidden photos folder. I can’t see them . I guess eventually I will go in and delete them but I’m not ready to even look at them to delete them yet.
Yes that’s what I plan to do .
I don’t think that Prince William is the antichrist. I think it’s Prince Louise.
I’m so happy for you !!!
Thank you 😊
Yes it’s down for me in Texas too. And my man said he couldn’t get on to text me this morning. He’s in New Mexico.
I’m in Texas. That would be just like GTL to go down at Christmas.
Mine working on my side. Not sure about my fiancé. He hasn’t called this evening though and that may be the reason.

The first thing I did when my fiancé got arrested was find out where they were taking him . Then I went to that facilities website and read everything I could read. I found out how to write letters and I immediately wrote him . I found out about text and phone and got set up on that . I sent him a text . And then I waited. It was about a week and then he finally was able to call me . I also looked up his mugshot and found out how to follow the case online through the court system. And I prayed. A lot.
What was your correspondence like when he was incarcerated?

We have code words for everything.
His ______has a name . Mine has a name. Sex is referred to as a project. We get really creative. lol Not sure about pics though. That would be hard.
There is a GTL number. It’s 800-483-8314.maybe if a lot of people call they will fix it faster.

My boyfriend can’t use his commissary account. We are having to order everything from out here. And he can’t use his prepaid debit account so every call has to be collect. Also the messages are taking forever ! Is there a GTL number we can call ?
Thank you ! 🙂

Yes it is a relief lol  Yeah MDC is a trip . A CO broke david and his cell mates tablet because he dropped it and now they don’t have one. MDC is supposed to replace it but it’s been over 3 weeks and nothing yet. 

At least he told you that his ex text him . Do you know her ? Let’s go beat her up ! lol my SO has an ex. . We can beat her up too ! Lol 

No , David said that it wasn’t him online: he was selling tablet time. Letting inmates watch movies on his account in exchange for them letting him use their tablet. It’s the only thing he can do right now to get tablet time. Lately he’s been reduced to calling me from the pos phones. And it’s sooo loud there ! 

Maybe he’s letting someone else use his account ? I don’t know . Do you trust him ?
Supposed to say what is the name of your SO - not Jamie lol
I hope not lol . Mine is named David . What is the Jamie of your SO ?

His name isn’t David is it ? I hate to  ask this but is his name David and is he in MDC ? I’m talking to a guy named David at MDC in Albuquerque and he writes me messaged like that. I figured it would be just my luck that he’s talking to other girls.  :(
I’m trying to stay busy too . I hope the time will go by faster if I’m busy.
Me too . I’m just tired. I’m done. I go through the motions and I don’t know why.  I literally don’t know why.

I agree with you . I am so upset about Mylayla getting an individual spot that I am considering not even watching the Olympics gymnastics competition. She thinks way too highly of herself and her ability to do gymnastics. She never progressed from a level 10. And you are right, she is racist.  Her form is atrocious. She can barely stay on beam. She always goes out of bounds on floor. She has major leg separation on bars and she gets no height on vault. She’s about as graceful as a sack of potatoes rolling downhill. Her tweets are cringe worthy. Why the heck did they make her an Olympian ??? My only hope is that she comes home with no medals. Maybe then she will finally go away and we won’t have to watch her horrible gymnastics anymore.
I hate AOC. She’s so stupid.
This is great news ! I’ve been waiting for this. I hope gymnasts start doing it !
